svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.27 CLADDING

g.text: Not less than No. 1 or Handsplit grade,
Not less than No. 2 grade. No. 3 grade may
At least B (clear) grade. C grade may be
used for the lower course of double course

svg.text: (a) CSA O118.1, "Western Red Cedar Shakes and
Shingles" or (b) CSA O118.2, "Eastern White Cedar
Western cedar shakes are not less than No. 1
or Handsplit grade, and western cedar shingles
not less than No. 2 grade, except that No. 3
grade may be used for undercoursing.
Eastern white cedar shingles are at least B
(clear) grade, except that C grade may be used
for the lower course of double course
As printed: no comma before "or" in Clause (1)(a). Shingle widths and exposure in A are illustration only.
